claim: Features: subscriber and list management, email campaigns, message tracking, reports, multiple workspaces/domains
Integrates with Amazon SES, Postmark, Sendgrid, Mailgun and Mailjet
V4 requires PHP 8.3+, Laravel 13, MySQL 5.7+ or PostgreSQL 10+
V2 and V3 are for earlier PHP and Laravel versions
SendPortal Core can be added to an existing Laravel application
Installation guide for the standalone application
Features list contains no automation builder and installation options list no Docker image
